$Comment: The binding row for the restless graveyard's endless run (EncounterManager/SeasonsOfOrbis/
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard_Encounter.json): what the server owes for it, which the script never
describes. Without a row the library keeps no run for an endless script and nothing rises, so this file
is what wakes the waves. NameKey names the run by the one who rides through it, the Voidtaken Horseman,
the same name his boss bar shows.
Subject is left to its Boss slot, which the run never fills: an endless run has no one boss to credit,
scale or pay. Its pay is the dungeon's, banked per cleared wave (Dungeons/
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard.json, Run.Endless.Chest), and its records are the dungeon's best
wave on Records' Endless Runs tab, so the row names no Loot and no Leaderboard.
Scale.Adds grows every creature the run raises with the party standing in it: a quarter more health for
each player beyond the first, up to double for a party of five, so a wave holds the same for a party as
it does alone. The dungeon's ramp grows them wave by wave on top of it, and Mob Scaling, where it runs,
on top of that. Switch the row off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounters.json under
